name: emit_final_asm_record_stream
note: (already named; unchanged) the final emission loop: reads records with read_next_backend_record, dispatches DC (emit_dc_record), DZ (emit_dz_record), DS, DSTR, section, B_ASM, C_JMP, labels, LINE, other ops through FUN_0040d7d0; holds the delay-slot record (g_delay_slot_record) and prints it after each branch

name: read_next_backend_record
note: (already named; signature kept as given)

name: emit_dz_record
note: OP_DZ case of emit_final_asm_record_stream: reads the size kind (1 byte: 0 B, 1 W, 2 L) and a 4-byte count from g_backend_record_input; object mode (request +0x12 == 1): count < 2 writes the zero data directly (FUN_00402227), otherwise an iterated-data object record (FUN_00402180(0xc0, 0x9c), section data offset, count, size, zero), advancing the section's location counter; listing / .src text: ".DATAB" + size suffix + count + string 00441e6c, line end FUN_0042b676

name: emit_dc_record
note: OP_DC case of emit_final_asm_record_stream: reads the size kind and item count from g_backend_record_input, then per item the value and a 4-byte symbol id; object mode: writes byte/word/long data (FUN_00402180 / FUN_00402227; byte-swapped with FUN_00427fc2 when request +0x2a), a long with a symbol goes through FUN_0042579b + FUN_00427769 (relocation), a byte/word with a symbol -> message 0x133c; listing ".DATA" + suffix and hex values; .src mode (stream 2): ".DATA" + suffix with hex values and symbol names (FUN_00427211)

name: read_label_ref_list
note: Reads count 2-byte label numbers from the backend record stream (g_backend_record_input, FUN_0042eea0) into a label_ref list: head->next = 0, labno1/labno2 filled in pairs, a new 8-byte node (FUN_0040cf00(8)) after every two; error 0xce6 on a read failure. Caller FUN_00424cc4 (the DC record) passes a stack label_ref, then hands it to emit_relocation_expression.

name: emit_reserve_record
note: OP_DS: reads 5 bytes from the backend stream {size code (0 byte, 1 word, else long), count (4)}. Object mode (request+0x12 == 1): advances the current section's location counter (g_section_location_counters[g_current_section_kind]) and g_section_object_offsets by size*count, sets g_object_record_break unless BSS, listing line when request+6 & 2. Source mode: writes ".RES" + ".B/.W/.L" (FUN_00423560) + count to stream 2.

name: emit_string_data_record
note: OP_DSTR: reads a 4-byte length then that many bytes from the backend stream. Object mode: each byte to the object data (FUN_00402180(b, 0x1c)), location counter +1 per byte, listing (stream 3) when request+6 & 2. Source mode (stream 2): printable runs as .SDATA "..." (doubling '"', wrapping at the line end DAT_0043cebc/DAT_0043ced8), unprintable bytes (is_unprintable_char) as .DATA.B H'xx lists.

name: switch_section
note: Section record (OP_PRGRAM/CONST/DATA/BSS = 0xc..0xf; callers emit_final_asm_record_stream, run_assembler_passes). Section id in rec->filno (+0xc); ids 2 and 3 ($G0/$G1, the GBR sections) force rec->op = 0xe DATA. Sets g_current_section_kind (0 P, 1 C, 2 D, 3 B), saves the old section's section numbers / location counters / object offsets into its section_layout (+0x18 of the section), finds the new section (find_section_by_id) and loads its values. Source mode writes ".SECTION <name>,CODE|DATA,ALIGN=32|16|8|4" (name from build_section_name; ALIGN=32 for code when request+0x13d & 8, 16 for code when request+0x14b, 8 for non-code when request+0x18 == 4); object listing mode copies the name (FUN_00423287).

name: emit_label_record
note: LABEL/CLABEL/DLABEL/FLABEL (callers emit_final_asm_record_stream, FUN_00416ff0). Label number in the ea1 slot (+0x10, as shcpep's define_label_at_location_counter has it). Finds the symbol (find_symbol_by_id); for a function (kind 1) computes the register save size (FUN_0042ec79*4, +4 unless frame flag 0x8000, +4 for 0x1800) and reports 0xc84 if the frame size overflows. In the program section, when the location counter differs from the label's position, fills the gap with NOPs (emit_alignment_fill(32, or 16 when request+0x14b)): the fill path the SHC_ALIGN_FILE knob relies on. Then writes the label (FUN_004232ef) and a comment by kind: "; function: name" (demangled via FUN_0042f330 when request+0x144), "; frame size=", "; used runtime library name:" (bitmap at frame+0x2c, names 0043cb24), "; case label", "; default label", "; label:", "; static:".

name: emit_alignment_fill
note: Error 0x133d unless 1 <= fill_bytes <= 31. Object mode: writes fill_bytes/2 SH NOP words (0x0009, byte order by the request+0x2a big-endian flag) to the object data (FUN_00402374 type 0x1c). Advances g_program_location_counter by fill_bytes. Listing/source: ".ALIGN <alignment>". Callers emit_label_record (32 or 16), emit_literal_pool (32).

name: emit_line_comment
note: OP_LINE: when the request asks for source comments, writes "; File <basename padded to 10> Line <n>" and the statement kind ("; block", "; if", "; while", ... table 00441f88, index = byte at rec+0x10). File from rec->filno through the request+0xec source_file list, name via get_source_file_basename; line = rec->linno. Stream 3 (listing) when request+6 & 2, else 2.

name: emit_line_directive
signature (C prototype; empty = Ghidra's: void emit_line_directive(unsigned int filno, unsigned int linno)
note: Writes .LINE "<path>",<line> to the source stream (2). The path is the request+0xec source_file entry with that file number, expanded by FUN_0042ef50 (copy of up to 0xfc chars); the stored name is used when that fails or the result is longer than 0xe0. Both parameters are used as their low 16 bits. Caller FUN_00420348.

name: emit_inline_asm_block
note: OP_B_ASM: copies an inline assembler block to the source output. Error 0x132f in object mode. Seeks g_inline_asm_input (request+0xa0) to rec+0x10, reads 3 shorts and a 4-byte length, copies the text in chunks of up to 30 bytes with g_listing_raw_text_mode set. For a non-empty block a fresh label "L<n>:" (g_last_label_number+1, error 0xbc8 at 0x7fff) is written first when g_inline_asm_needs_label is already set (two blocks with no label/section between them); then sets it. Ends with ".ALIGN 4" and advances g_program_location_counter by rec+0x14 (the block's size), or 0x1000 when that is 0, rounded up to 4.

name: print_label_sum_from_backend_stream
signature (C prototype; empty = Ghidra's: void print_label_sum_from_backend_stream(short stream, short count, short continued)
note: Reads count 2-byte label numbers from the backend stream and prints them as an expression to the stream: '+' before a positive label when something precedes (continued, then always), the label itself (FUN_004232ef prints '-' for a negative one). Caller FUN_00424cc4 (DC operands, stream 2).

name: print_label_ref_expression
signature (C prototype; empty = Ghidra's: void print_label_ref_expression(short stream, label_ref *refs, short continued)
note: Prints a label_ref list as "L1-L2+L3..." to the stream (FUN_004232ef for each labno1/labno2, '+' before positive terms after the first); stops at a NULL node or labno1 == 0, or after a node with labno2 == 0. Callers: the operand printers FUN_0040e072/0040e5e0/0040e787/0040e92e/0040ea8b.

name: get_source_file_basename
note: Copies the file name part (after the last '\', ':' or '/'; FUN_00434460) of file->path (+8) into out as a counted string: out[0] = length, then the characters (no terminator). Error 0x132e on failure. Caller emit_line_comment.

name: copy_source_lines_to_listing
signature (C prototype; empty = Ghidra's: void copy_source_lines_to_listing(char op, short filno, unsigned short linno)
note: Source-in-listing: reads {file (2), line (4)} headers and text lines (fgets 0x86) from g_source_listing_input (request+0x15c) and fputs them to the listing file (DAT_0043cee8) until the stream passes the given file/line; starts a new page (FUN_0042b864) when the page line count exceeds request+0xc - 4. Skips op 0x11 (C_JMP), line 0, and the file/line printed last (DAT_00441e58/DAT_00441e5c). Sets g_source_listing_at_end at EOF. Caller emit_final_asm_record_stream (0x7fff/0xffff flushes the rest).

name: reverse_bits_16
note: Returns the 16 bits of value in reverse order (bit 0 -> bit 15). No callers in the export (dead code). Return kept 4 bytes; the high half is (loop counter 0x10) >> 15 = 0. LOW HALF: returns 2 bytes; the stock code leaves a leftover in the high half (Ghidra showed CONCAT22) and every caller reads only the low half: narrowing removed the callers' extraout_/CONCAT and added none.

name: is_unprintable_char
note: 1 unless 0x20 <= ch <= 0x7e. The high half of the 4-byte return is the sign of ch (CONCAT22); the only caller (emit_string_data_record) tests the low 16 bits; kept 4 bytes. LOW HALF: returns 2 bytes; the stock code leaves a leftover in the high half (Ghidra showed CONCAT22) and every caller reads only the low half: narrowing removed the callers' extraout_/CONCAT and added none.

name: emit_relocation_expression
signature (C prototype; empty = Ghidra's: int emit_relocation_expression(label_ref *refs, int offset, int location, int size_bits, int extra_operand, int mode)
note: SIG widths kept (6th stack argument, see shcasm functions.tsv). Writes one object-file relocation expression record: header FUN_0040289d(location, size_bits 0x10/0x20, mode), then one term per label (emit_relocation_symbol_term) joined by 0x20 (+) / 0x21 (-) / 0x24 (leading negate) operator bytes, the symbols' positions summed into offset; a constant term {3, 4, offset(4), 0x20} when size_bits <= 0x10 and offset != 0 (offset then returned as 0); {0x25, 1, extra_operand} when extra_operand != 0; 0xff end; patches the record length byte (g_object_expr_write_ptr) and flushes (FUN_004029b2(0,0)). Returns the constant part left for the data word. Callers: FUN_0040e072, FUN_0040ea8b, FUN_00417bfa, FUN_00424cc4, emit_literal_pool_entry.

name: emit_relocation_symbol_term
note: One term of a relocation expression for symbol |labno|. 0x8000: section-start term {5, short at +4 of the second section's layout}, returns 0. A symbol defined here (kinds 1-5, 7-9): term {0, section number sym+0x1a (refreshed from the section's layout for kind 2)}. Otherwise (external): term {2, sym+0x28}. Returns the symbol's position (sym+8), negated for a negative labno. Caller emit_relocation_expression.

name: find_symbol_by_id
note: Looks the symbol id up in the 0x3fd-bucket hash table g_symbol_hash_buckets (bucket id % 0x3fd, chain at +0x14). Fatal 0x136b for id -0x8000, 0x136a when not found (the "symbol lookup miss" of notes/shcasm.md). Returns the 0x2c-byte symbol record (Ghidra int, same width). Many callers.

name: immediate_bit_width
signature (C prototype; empty = Ghidra's: int immediate_bit_width(char signedness, unsigned int value)
note: Smallest field width for value: 0 for 0; 's' signed: 8, 9, 10 or 13 bits, else 0x20; 'u' unsigned: 4, 5, 6, 8, 9 or 10 bits, else 0x20; any other signedness: 0x20. No callers in the export (dead code).

name: print_label_ref_expression_to_listing
note: print_label_ref_expression for the listing stream (3): prints each labno1 (with '+' when positive and not first) and a nonzero labno2 (with '+' when positive) until labno1 == 0 or the end of the list. Callers: operand printers, FUN_00417bfa, FUN_00424cc4, emit_literal_pool_entry.

name: build_section_name
note: Writes the section's name into out: "$G0"/"$G1" for section ids 2/3, else the default name for the kind (request+0x50/+0x54/+0x58/+0x5c for P/C/D/B) followed by the section's name suffix (section+4, length section+2). A name of 32 or more characters: error 0xa96, g_max_error_severity = 3, and the single letter from "PCDB". Returns the name length in the low byte (high bytes are leftovers; switch_section ignores it, FUN_00423287 and FUN_00412cda use the low byte). Ghidra char *, kept 4 bytes.

name: byte_swap_value
signature (C prototype; empty = Ghidra's: void byte_swap_value(unsigned int *out, unsigned int *in, int size_code)
note: size_code 1: out = the low 16 bits of *in byte-swapped; 2: out = *in with its 4 bytes reversed; other values leave out alone. Used for big-endian object data (request+0x2a). Callers FUN_00417bfa, FUN_00424cc4, emit_literal_pool_entry.

name: symbol_address_is_abs16
note: 1 when the symbol's address fits a 16-bit literal: request+0x154 == 3 (all symbols), or a predefined/runtime symbol (id < 0xb7) with request+0x154 & 1, or a symbol with attribute bit 0x20 (sym+2). Callers FUN_0042be20 (word table 00447670 when 1, long table 00447880 when 0) and FUN_0042ded3.

name: get_symbol_attribute_bits
note: SIG kept (int). Returns sym+2 & 3 for ids > 0xb6, else 0 (the low two attribute bits loaded from the .asb record). Callers (FUN_00418033, FUN_00420670, FUN_0042be20, FUN_0042df28, FUN_0042e390) combine it with the function frame flags & 0x1800 (0x1000/0x1800) to size a load of the frame's +0x10 symbol; what the values 1/2 mean is not established.

name: find_section_by_id
note: Walks the request's section list (request+0x24, next at +0x1c) for the section with that id; fatal 0x12ed when absent. Callers pass g_current_request. Return Ghidra short *, same width.

name: add_literal_to_pool_table
signature (C prototype; empty = Ghidra's: void add_literal_to_pool_table(unsigned int value, label_ref *refs, int pass, int is_long)
note: Records a literal (value + label terms) in one of four literal pool hash tables: pass 0 -> g_pool_words (00447670) / g_pool_longs (00447880), pass 1 -> g_pool2_words (0044a6e0) / g_pool2_longs (0044a900); is_long picks the long table. Adds it only when not already present (FUN_0042d8fa lookup, FUN_0042dc08 insert). On the first literal of a pass-1 pool it makes the pool's label: g_last_label_number+1 (0xbc8 at 0x7fff) into g_literal_pool_label, a kind-0xf symbol (FUN_00416e00) in the pass-2 section, and its 2 bytes byte-swapped to the temp stream (FUN_004138e9). Callers: the per-op layout handlers FUN_004218bd, 00421d5b, 004222bd, 00422672, 004227c2, 00422915, 00422ac2, 00422b68 (pass = their own mode argument).

name: find_literal_pool_index
note: 1-based position of the literal (value + label terms, compared by FUN_0042d9b1) in the table's insertion-order list; fatal 0x134c when absent. Callers: the instruction encoders FUN_00419b8d, 0041a148, 0041a982, 0041c4d9, 0041ca2c, 0041cd09, 0041d1e0, 0041d57a (pool displacement).

name: emit_literal_pool
note: Emits the pending literal pool at g_literal_pool_label: NOP fill up to the label's position in the program section (emit_alignment_fill(32, gap)), the label line, every word literal (g_pool_words, emit_literal_pool_entry size 1), 2 bytes of padding (".RES.W 1", location +2) when there are long literals and g_program_location_counter is not a multiple of 4, every long literal (g_pool_longs, size 2); then empties both tables (FUN_0042dd9b). Callers emit_final_asm_record_stream (after a record with flg & 0x10 while either table is non-empty) and FUN_00416ff0.

name: emit_literal_pool_entry
signature (C prototype; empty = Ghidra's: void emit_literal_pool_entry(unsigned int value, label_ref *refs, int size_code)
note: One literal pool entry; size_code 1 = word (.DATA.W, 2 bytes), 2 = long (.DATA.L, 4 bytes), else error 0x134d. Object mode: the value, or for a label expression the constant left by emit_relocation_expression(refs, value, location, 16/32, 0, 1), written as object data (FUN_00402227), byte-swapped when request+0x2a; listing line when request+6 & 2. Source mode: ".DATA.W/.L H'value" or "H'offset+L1-L2...". Advances g_program_location_counter by 2 or 4. Caller emit_literal_pool.

name: layout_literal_pool
note: Literal pool sizing at a pool point (rec = the RETURN/JUMP/EXIT/BRA... layout record; rec->pool_size +0x18 is shcpep's estimate; the pool starts at rec->location + rec->size). Pass 0 reads the pool decision byte from g_lit_input: no pool here -> the whole estimate (all but 0xe with 16-byte alignment) goes into g_layout_pass1_shrink; pool -> size = words*2 + longs*4 + 2 (+0x10 with request+0x14b, +0x3e with request+0x13d & 8, in place of +2), estimate minus size into the shrink. Pass 1: exact padding (2 when the long part would be misaligned; 32-/16-byte alignment modes), sets the pool label's position (sym+8) and the long part's position (sym+0x24), adds estimate - size to g_layout_pass2_shrink. Stores the new size in rec->pool_size and empties that pass's tables. Callers: layout handlers FUN_00421388, 004216f5, 00421d5b, 00422ee9 (pass = their mode argument).

name: report_message_at_source_line
signature (C prototype; empty = Ghidra's: void report_message_at_source_line(short filno, unsigned int linno, short msg_code, char *text)
note: Existing name report_message_by_symbol_id was wrong: its first two arguments are a source file number (looked up in request->source_files, as .LINE and "; File" do with rec->filno) and line (callers pass rec.filno, rec.linno); then the message code and text (s09).

name: run_layout_passes
note: The first layout pass (caller shcasm_main, before run_assembler_passes); runs both layout passes and turns shcpep's estimated label positions into final ones. Gives every section a 0x30-byte section_layout (FUN_0040cf00(0x30) at section+0x18), begin_layout_passes, then pass 1: walks the symbol table from the first label (g_layout_pass1_symbol, kinds < 6, step 0x2c), clears sym->layout_records, switches section state when sym+0x18 changes (saving/restoring the running shrink in section_layout+0x28), subtracts the running shrink g_layout_pass1_shrink from sym+8 (the SHC_ALIGN_FILE hook point), and when the symbol is the label the .ofb stream stands at (g_ofb_current_label) runs layout_next_ofb_record until the next label record (0x18..0x1b). Then pass 2 (FUN_0042ac37: the stored records again with g_layout_pass2_shrink, handlers mode 1; FUN_0042abe1 also runs it early when calloc fails) for the leading queue and every symbol; stores the shrinks in the current sections' layouts (+0x28/+0x2c) and calls finish_layout_passes.

name: begin_layout_passes
note: Layout set-up: g_ofb_at_end = 0; g_layout_pass1_symbol = g_layout_pass2_symbol = the first symbol of kind <= 5 in g_symbol_table; both passes start in section 1 with its stored shrinks (layout +0x28/+0x2c); g_layout_pass2_label_id (and g_layout_pass2_function_label for kind 1) from it. Opens the .ofb stream (request+0x90, or +0x94 when request+4 != 0) as g_ofb_input; op 0x10 records before the first label are read (FUN_0042abe1 + 2x4 bytes), laid out at once (FUN_00422d35 mode 0) and queued on g_layout_leading_records; the first label's number goes to g_ofb_current_label (FLABEL: g_current_function_label / frame index). Allocates the temp output buffer (FUN_0041371d), opens g_lit_input (request+0xa4) and reads its first byte. Fatal 0xce4/0xce6 on open/read failure.

name: finish_layout_passes
note: Layout end: flushes the temp output buffer (FUN_0041399e), closes g_ofb_input and g_lit_input (0xce5 on failure); for every section subtracts both pass shrinks (layout +0x28 + +0x2c) from its program size (section+8) and totals the four sizes (P/C/D/B) into g_total_section_size with an overflow check. Object mode: overflow -> error 0xc81. Source mode: on overflow every size becomes 1, otherwise each size and the total become 0/1 flags.

name: layout_next_ofb_record
note: Pass 1 step: reads one op byte from g_ofb_input (EOF -> g_ofb_at_end = 1, returns 0). Label records 0x18..0x1b: read the label number into g_ofb_current_label; FLABEL also sets g_current_function_label and g_current_function_frame_index (symbol +0x10). Other ops: read_ofb_layout_record, then the op's layout handler with mode 0 (0x10 FUN_00422d35, 0x11 FUN_00420a51, 0x20 FUN_00420670, 0x21 FUN_00421388, 0x22 FUN_004216f5, 0x23 FUN_004218bd, 0x24 FUN_00421d5b, 0x25/0x26 FUN_00421ffd, 0x27 FUN_004222bd, 0x28 FUN_00422672, 0x29 FUN_004227c2, 0x2a FUN_00422915, 0x2b FUN_00422b68, 0x2c FUN_00422ac2, 0x2e FUN_00422dd0, 0x8e/0x92/0x94/0x96 FUN_00422ee9; FUN_0042aef0 is the same switch with mode 1). Returns the op; the only caller (run_layout_passes) tests the char.

name: read_ofb_layout_record
note: Allocates a 0x20-byte layout_record (FUN_0042abe1, calloc(1,0x20)), stores op at +4 and reads the rest of the op's .ofb record (the formats of shcpep's write_ofb_* writers): size +5, misc +6, flags +7, location +8, disp +0x10, label terms as a label_ref list at +0x14 (count, then 2-byte numbers two per node) or the sptravel / raw word, pool_size +0x18, +0x1a. Error 0x1374 for any other op. Appends it to the current symbol's list (g_layout_pass1_symbol->layout_records first, then via g_layout_record_tail). Callers layout_next_ofb_record, FUN_00420a51. Returns the record (Ghidra int, same width).

name: alloc_layout_record
note: calloc(1,0x20) (FUN_00435550) of a pending layout record; while that fails, resolves one pending record (resolve_next_pending_layout_record) to free memory, and reports 0xbcd (out of memory) only when nothing was left to resolve. Callers: FUN_0042926d (B_ASM/0x10 records into g_layout_record_queue), FUN_00429c0d (reads the per-op fields from the layout input file). Ghidra return LPVOID; layout_record in types_proposal.h.

name: resolve_next_pending_layout_record
note: Signature kept (the lead's int, see the existing note). If g_layout_record_queue is non-empty, resolves its head (resolve_layout_record) and returns 1. Otherwise walks the symbol cursor g_layout_symbol_cursor over the 0x2c-byte symbol records (up to g_layout_symbol_last): a section change (symbol +0x18 != current section number) saves g_layout_section_shrink into the old section (+0xc -> +0x2c) and loads the new section (FUN_00428140); subtracts the shrink from each passed symbol's value (+8); remembers the symbol number (+6) in g_layout_symbol_labno and, for kind 1 (function), in g_layout_function_labno; takes the symbol's pending record list (+0x24) into g_layout_symbol_pending and resolves one record of it (returns 1); returns 0 when nothing was resolved. Callers: FUN_00429060 (the first layout pass loops on it until the queue and the cursor are exhausted), alloc_layout_record.

name: resolve_layout_record
note: Dispatches on rec->op to the per-op layout handlers with mode 1 (0x10 FUN_00422d35, 0x11 FUN_00420a51, 0x20 ENTER FUN_00420670, 0x21 EXIT FUN_00421388, 0x22 RETURN FUN_004216f5, 0x23 CALL FUN_004218bd, 0x24 JUMP FUN_00421d5b, 0x25/0x26 JUMPT/JUMPF FUN_00421ffd, 0x27 MV_LOC FUN_004222bd, 0x28 MVA_LC FUN_00422672, 0x29 MVA_PC FUN_004227c2, 0x2a MOVI FUN_00422915, 0x2b MVA_FC FUN_00422b68, 0x2c MOVIF FUN_00422ac2, 0x2e FPRSET FUN_00422dd0, RTE/BRA/JMP/RTS 0x8e/0x92/0x94/0x96 FUN_00422ee9); prints "CODE %02x Offset %08x" when request +0x13c & 2 and rec->location != 0; frees the label list at +0x14 (8-byte nodes, FUN_0040d5cb) except for ops 0x27/0x28/0x11/0x14 where +0x14 is not a list; frees rec (FUN_00435290) and returns rec->next. Only caller resolve_next_pending_layout_record. Ghidra had int return / int * param.

name: frame_offset_to_sp_displacement_for_pass
signature (C prototype; empty = Ghidra's: int frame_offset_to_sp_displacement_for_pass(int frame_offset, int sp_travel, int pass)
note: The computation of frame_offset_to_sp_displacement (aux.frame_size + sp_travel + frame_offset, plus 4*count_saved_registers and +4 when aux flags 0x8000 clear for frame_offset >= 0; just +4 for a negative offset), but the function comes from a symbol picked by pass: 2 -> g_emit_function_labno (FLABEL of the emit pass), 0 -> g_read_function_labno, else g_layout_function_labno; its aux index is the symbol's +0x10 (FUN_00427a7d). Callers FUN_0041a982, FUN_0041c4d9 (emit handlers), FUN_004222bd / FUN_00422672 (MV_LOC / MVA_LC layout handlers).

name: put_char_at_column
signature (C prototype; empty = Ghidra's: void put_char_at_column(short channel, char c, short column)
note: Makes a 1-character string and calls put_text_at_column. Many callers (the .src/listing text writers 0040d7d0, 004232ef, ...).

name: put_text_at_column
signature (C prototype; empty = Ghidra's: void put_text_at_column(short channel, char *text, short column)
note: Appends text to the line buffer of g_output_channels[channel] (0x1c-byte records: buffer, end, cursor, ..., FILE *), first moving the cursor up to g_column_starts[column] when it is before it (unless g_line_wrap_disabled). When the buffer is full: with g_line_wrap_disabled == 1 writes the buffer out (fputs, 0xce7) and restarts it; with 0 breaks the line after the last ',' (0xc83 for channel 2 when there is none), flushes (channel 2 flush_src_line, else flush_listing_line), puts '+' (continuation) at the channel's mark (0043cec0 / g_listing_continuation_mark) and copies the carried text to the column. After the text, for column 0, flushes when the cursor reached column 3. Channels: 2 = the .src assembly text, 3 = the listing (004131a0 opens them and sets their column starts).

name: flush_output_line
note: channel 2 -> flush_src_line, else flush_listing_entry. Many callers in the .src/listing writers.

name: flush_listing_line
note: If the listing line holds text (cursor past g_column_starts[0]) or object-code rows remain (g_listing_code_row_next <= g_listing_code_row_last): copies the next 10-character code row of g_listing_code_rows into the code column (g_listing_code_column), ends the line with "\n", counts it (g_listing_line_count), emits a page header (emit_listing_page_header) when the count passes the page length (request +0xc) - 4, fputs it to the listing file (0xce7), resets the cursor and blanks the line. Callers put_text_at_column, flush_listing_entry.

name: emit_listing_page_header
note: Increments g_listing_page_number; after page 1 first writes 4 blank lines; sets the line count to 1; formats the page banner with the page number (FUN_004348a0) into g_listing_header_buffer and writes it. On page 1 also writes "************ OBJECT LISTING ************" and either "Object program is empty." or "FILE NAME: " + the source name (request +0) wrapped to the line width. When the program is not empty writes "SCT OFFSET   CODE       C LABEL" + "     INSTRUCTION OPERAND    COMMENT". Callers run_assembler_passes, FUN_00427458, flush_listing_line.

name: copy_string_count
note: strcpy that returns the number of characters copied (without the NUL). Only caller emit_listing_page_header.

name: copy_string_to_line_width
note: Copies src to dst until the NUL or (line width - column) characters (line width = request +8, default 0x84), then stores the next source character (the NUL when complete); returns the count copied. Only caller emit_listing_page_header (wraps the FILE NAME line).

name: pad_listing_page
note: Writes the blank line g_listing_blank_line (write_listing_line) until g_listing_line_count reaches the page length (request +0xc). Caller run_assembler_passes.

name: write_listing_line
note: Stores "\n\0" at end, fputs line to the listing file (g_output_channels[3].file, 0043cee8; 0xce7 on error) and increments g_listing_line_count. Callers emit_listing_page_header, pad_listing_page.

name: flush_listing_entry
note: Calls flush_listing_line while the line holds text or code rows remain, then resets the code rows: g_listing_code_column_pos = 10, g_listing_code_row_last = 0xffff (none), g_listing_code_row_next = 0. Only caller flush_output_line.

name: flush_src_line
note: If the .src line buffer (g_output_channels[2]: buffer 0043ceb8, cursor 0043cec0) holds text: ends it with "\n", fputs it to its file (0043cecc; 0xce7 on error), resets the cursor and blanks the buffer up to its end (0043cebc). Callers put_text_at_column, flush_output_line.

name: decide_literal_pool_placement
note: DEAD CODE in shcasm: no call and no pointer to 0042be20 anywhere in the image. The literal-pool placement rule shcpep names decide_literal_pool_placement (shcpep 004179a0), same globals layout: collects each record's literals into g_word_literal_table / g_long_literal_table / g_frame_offset_literal_table (find_pool_literal / add_pool_literal), counts code bytes (compute_record_code_size) and literal bytes, and at RTE/BRA/JMP/RTS/JUMP/EXIT/RETURN decides whether to place the pool (limits 0x3fc/0x1fe, 0x3cc/0x1ce), writing the 1-byte decision to lit_out (write_file_bytes). Returns pool size + 2, or 0. Kept the shcpep name.

name: find_pool_literal
signature (C prototype; empty = Ghidra's: int find_pool_literal(literal_table *table, unsigned int value, label_ref *labels)
note: Hash = (value + every labno1 + labno2) % 0x7f; walks the bucket chain (entry +4) calling pool_literal_matches; returns 1 when found, else 0. Same as shcpep find_pool_literal. Callers pass 0x447670/0x447880/0x447a90 (the three literal tables): FUN_00419b8d, FUN_0041a148, FUN_0041a982, FUN_0041c4d9, FUN_0041ca2c, FUN_0041cd09, FUN_0041d1e0, FUN_004281b0, decide_literal_pool_placement.

name: pool_literal_matches
note: 1 if entry->value (+8) == value and entry's label list (+0xc) holds the same labno1/labno2 multiset as labels (20-flag scratch array), else 0. Callers find_pool_literal, FUN_004282e6. Same as shcpep pool_literal_matches.

name: add_pool_literal
signature (C prototype; empty = Ghidra's: void add_pool_literal(literal_table *table, unsigned int value, label_ref *labels)
note: Allocates a 0x10-byte literal_entry (FUN_0040cf00(0x10)) holding value and a copy of the label list (8-byte nodes), appends it to bucket (value + labnos) % 0x7f (chain +4) and to the insertion list (head +0, tail +4), count +8 ++. Same as shcpep add_pool_literal. Callers: the emit handlers 00419b8d..0041d57a, FUN_004281b0, decide_literal_pool_placement.

name: clear_pool_literal_table
note: Frees every entry (FUN_0040d5cb(e,0x10)) and its 8-byte label nodes, zeroes the 0x7f buckets, then head/tail/count; internal error 0x12f2 when the freed count != count. Same as shcpep. Callers FUN_00420a51, FUN_0042836b, FUN_00428aa3, decide_literal_pool_placement.

name: write_pool_flush_flag
note: DEAD CODE: no call and no pointer anywhere. Writes the single byte 1 to lit_out (write_file_bytes; 0xce7 on error): the "true" value of the 1-byte pool decision that decide_literal_pool_placement writes.

name: is_word_symbol_literal
note: 1 if labels is non-NULL with labno2 == 0 and FUN_0042805a(labno1) (the symbol fits a word literal: request +0x154 == 3, or bit 0 for runtime labels <= 0xb6, or symbol attr bit 0x20) is nonzero, else 0; value is unused. Same as shcpep is_word_symbol_literal. Callers FUN_00419b8d, FUN_0041a148, FUN_0041cd09, FUN_004218bd, FUN_00421d5b, FUN_00422915, decide_literal_pool_placement.

name: get_marked_symbol_attr_low_bits
note: Signature kept (the lead's int). For a single label_ref (next == NULL) whose labno2 is the marker -0x8000, returns FUN_004280f6(labno1) (the symbol's attribute byte +2 & 3, 0..3); otherwise 0. Callers compare the result with 1 and 2 (MOVI handling in FUN_0041cd09, FUN_00422915, decide_literal_pool_placement).

name: evaluate_label_expression
note: value plus, for every label_ref, the value (+8) of the symbol of labno1 and of labno2 (FUN_00427a7d): added when the number is > 0, subtracted when it is < 0, skipped when 0. Callers (the .src/listing writers) FUN_0040e072, FUN_0040e5e0, FUN_0040e787, FUN_0040e92e, FUN_0040ea8b pass ea->disp and ea->labels.

name: check_operand_registers
note: Checks op->base/index against the EA kind (type & 0x1f), reporting 0x133b when out of range: kind 1 base 0..0x60; 2/3/4/8/9 base 0..0xf (9 also index == 0); 5 base 0x61..0x63 (SR/GBR/VBR); 6 base 0x64..0x66 (MACH/MACL/PR); 10 base 0x6b; 11 base 0x62 (GBR); 12 base 0x62 and index 0; 0xf base 0x67 (FPUL); 0x10 base 0x68 (FPSCR); kinds 0, 0xd and unknown always. Also turns a kind-8 @(disp,Rn) with disp 0 and no labels into kind 2 @Rn (type = type & 0xf0 | 2). Caller FUN_0040d7d0 (for rec->ea1 and rec->ea2).

name: compute_record_code_size
note: Target code bytes of the record: base from g_op_code_size_table[op] (short per op, 004421b0), adjusted for 0x10 (even length + 2, the length in the +0x14 slot), CTBL (count at +0xc * 4), ENTER/EXIT/RETURN (frame setup, saved registers via count_saved_registers, aux flags; RETURN with >= 2 saved registers takes the OP_JUMP element 004421f8), MV_LOC (8x8 byte table at 004423b0 by access kind and displacement range, via frame_offset_to_sp_displacement), MVA_LC, MOVI, MOVIF, MOV; minus 2 when flg & 0x40. Callers use the low 16 bits: FUN_00420670, FUN_00420a51, FUN_00421388, FUN_00421ffd, FUN_00422dd0, decide_literal_pool_placement. Same as shcpep compute_record_code_size; Ghidra's 4-byte return kept. LOW HALF: returns 2 bytes; the stock code leaves a leftover in the high half (Ghidra showed CONCAT22) and every caller reads only the low half: narrowing removed the callers' extraout_/CONCAT and added none.

name: count_saved_registers
note: Counts the set bits of g_aux_record_table[aux_index] masks +4 and +6 (16 bits each), minus 1 for bit 15 and 1 for bit 0 of +4 when flags +0xa has 0x4000 and 0x1800, plus +0x17 bits 0/1 (MACL/MACH) and +8 bits 0/1. Callers use the low 16 bits. Same as shcpep count_saved_registers. LOW HALF: returns 2 bytes; the stock code leaves a leftover in the high half (Ghidra showed CONCAT22) and every caller reads only the low half: narrowing removed the callers' extraout_/CONCAT and added none.

name: frame_offset_to_sp_displacement
note: aux.frame_size (+0 of g_aux_record_table[g_current_aux_index]) + sp_travel + frame_offset, plus 4*count_saved_registers (+4 when aux flags 0x8000 clear) for frame_offset >= 0, or +4 for a negative offset. Callers compute_record_code_size and decide_literal_pool_placement pass ea->disp and psd.sptravel of MV_LOC/MVA_LC. Same as shcpep.

name: read_file_bytes
signature (C prototype; empty = Ghidra's: unsigned int read_file_bytes(FILE *in, char *buf, unsigned int n)
note: fread(buf,1,n,in) (__fread_lk); -1 for a NULL file/buffer or n < 1; when nothing was read: 0 at a clean EOF (_flag 0x10 without 0x20), else -1. Same as shcpep read_file_bytes. About 45 callers.

name: write_file_bytes
signature (C prototype; empty = Ghidra's: unsigned int write_file_bytes(FILE *out, char *buf, unsigned int n)
note: fwrite(buf, n, 1, out) (FUN_004358f0); returns n, or -1 on failure, a NULL file/buffer or n < 1. Same as shcpep write_file_bytes.

name: get_full_path
note: FUN_00435a70(out, path, 0xfc) = CRT _fullpath (GetFullPathNameA). LEAD DECIDE: Ghidra says void, but the body leaves _fullpath's char * result in EAX and both callers (emit_object_header_and_tables, FUN_00426d1d) test it (== 0 -> fallback); the return should be char *. RETURN: returns stock_fullpath's result (EAX is left as it returned it); both callers test it (emit_object_header_and_tables, emit_line_directive read it as extraout_EAX with a void signature).

signature (C prototype; empty = Ghidra's: unsigned int store_u32_big_endian(unsigned int *value, unsigned int *out)

note: *out = *value byte-swapped; junk return (callers ignore it). Many object-writer callers.

note: strstr: the first position of needle in haystack, NULL if none (or needle empty). Only caller FUN_00406541. Ghidra typed needle int *.

name: open_temp_file
note: Returns 0 when 8 temp files are already open; otherwise make_temp_file_name() + ".tmp", opened "wb+" (0xce4 on failure; 0xbcd on allocation failure, both exit 9), recorded as {path, FILE *} in g_temp_files[g_temp_file_count++]. Ghidra's int is the FILE *. Callers FUN_004138e9, FUN_0041e360, FUN_00433920. Same as shcpep open_temp_file.

name: close_and_delete_temp_files
note: For each g_temp_files entry: fclose (0xce5, exit 9), delete the file (FUN_0043ac30, 0xce8), free the path; then g_temp_file_count = 0. Callers shcasm_main, report_message_by_symbol_id, FUN_004343d0, FUN_004347c0. Same as shcpep.

name: make_temp_file_name
note: Directory from FUN_00434c70(g_tmp_env_name) ("" when unset, 0xcf9 when too long), then sprintf("%s%d.%d", dir, abs(GetCurrentProcessId()), g_temp_name_counter++) into a malloc'd buffer sized from tmpnam and the pid digit count (g_temp_name_buffer). Only caller open_temp_file. Same as shcpep.

name: demangle_cpp_symbol_name
note: C++ name demangler entry. Only caller FUN_004262e0 (listing writer: "; function: " comment when request+0x144 != 0) passes '_' + the symbol name and prints *demangled on (short)result == 0, else the raw name. Needs "__" at the start; copies the function name until a "__" that parse_mangled_signature_kind accepts (kind 0..7 = global function / class member / static member / cv member, see there). Kinds 5..7: builds " const"/" volatile" text in g_demangle_cv_suffix. Kinds 1,2,3,4,6,7: format_class_scope_prefix -> g_demangle_class_scope ("A::B::") + innermost class name. Name: "__ct"/"__dt" (find_ctor_dtor_name_code) -> class name / "~"+class name; operator codes (find_operator_name_code) -> "operator+" ...; "__op<type>" conversion -> "operator " + format_mangled_type_list(type, buffer 2). Kinds 0,1,2,5,6,7: demangle_argument_list(..., 2) then "(" + work buffer b + ")" + cv suffix. All text goes to work buffer 1 (append_to_work_buffer), *demangled = g_work_buffer_a. Returns low half 0 ok, 0xffff (-1) bad name, 2 out of memory. LOW HALF: returns 2 bytes; the stock code leaves a leftover in the high half (Ghidra showed CONCAT22) and every caller reads only the low half: narrowing removed the callers' extraout_/CONCAT and added none.

name: format_class_scope_prefix
note: class_code is a length-prefixed name ("3Foo") or "Q<n>__" + n names. Writes "Foo::" (each component + "::", 00442bcc) to scope and the last component to class_name (for constructor/destructor names). Uses parse_length_prefixed_name into g_demangle_name_scratch (004446b0). Returns low half 0 ok, 0xffff error. Caller demangle_cpp_symbol_name. LOW HALF: returns 2 bytes; the stock code leaves a leftover in the high half (Ghidra showed CONCAT22) and every caller reads only the low half: narrowing removed the callers' extraout_/CONCAT and added none.

name: parse_decimal_digits
note: *value = decimal value of the digit string, *length = number of characters. Used by every length-prefixed / counted mangling code reader (parse_length_prefixed_name, copy_length_prefixed_name, format_qualified_name, format_type_back_reference, format_placeholder_type ...).

name: copy_length_prefixed_name
note: Copies a mangled "<len><name>" code verbatim (digits included) to dst, *consumed = digits + len. 0xffff if len is 0 or the string ends early. Callers demangle_argument_list (tokenizer, class 5) and copy_qualified_name_code. LOW HALF: returns 2 bytes; the stock code leaves a leftover in the high half (Ghidra showed CONCAT22) and every caller reads only the low half: narrowing removed the callers' extraout_/CONCAT and added none.

name: copy_qualified_name_code
note: Copies a mangled "Q<n>__" + n length-prefixed names code verbatim (strncpy FUN_00435520) to dst and NUL-terminates; *consumed = its length. Checks the two '_' after the count. 0xffff on error. Callers parse_mangled_signature_kind, demangle_argument_list (class 0xb), copy_member_pointer_code. LOW HALF: returns 2 bytes; the stock code leaves a leftover in the high half (Ghidra showed CONCAT22) and every caller reads only the low half: narrowing removed the callers' extraout_/CONCAT and added none.

name: copy_array_dimension_codes
note: Copies a run of mangled array codes "A<n>_A<m>_..." verbatim: stops at the first '_' not followed by 'A'; *consumed includes that '_'. 0xffff if no closing '_'. Callers demangle_argument_list (class 6) and format_array_dimensions. LOW HALF: returns 2 bytes; the stock code leaves a leftover in the high half (Ghidra showed CONCAT22) and every caller reads only the low half: narrowing removed the callers' extraout_/CONCAT and added none.

name: copy_type_back_reference_code
note: Copies 'T' plus the following digits verbatim (a back reference to an earlier argument type); *consumed = length. 0xffff if nothing follows the 'T'. Caller demangle_argument_list (class 8). LOW HALF: returns 2 bytes; the stock code leaves a leftover in the high half (Ghidra showed CONCAT22) and every caller reads only the low half: narrowing removed the callers' extraout_/CONCAT and added none.

name: copy_member_pointer_code
note: Copies 'M' + the class code (copy_qualified_name_code for 'Q', else copy_length_prefixed_name) verbatim; *consumed = 1 + class code length. Caller demangle_argument_list (class 7). LOW HALF: returns 2 bytes; the stock code leaves a leftover in the high half (Ghidra showed CONCAT22) and every caller reads only the low half: narrowing removed the callers' extraout_/CONCAT and added none.

name: intern_token_text
note: Appends text (NUL-terminated) to g_demangle_token_pool (0044e330) at g_demangle_token_pool_used and returns its offset. Caller push_demangle_token.

name: intern_placeholder_name
note: Same as intern_token_text for g_demangle_placeholder_name_pool (0044ffa0) / g_demangle_placeholder_name_pool_used (0044f740). Caller demangle_argument_list (the "$$%03d" names).

name: alloc_type_piece_string
note: Copies text into the type-piece string chunks (g_demangle_piece_chunk_current; a new 0x808-byte chunk {next, used, data[0x800]} when it would pass 0x800) and returns the copy. Allocation failure: free_demangle_string_chunks, returns 0. Caller push_type_piece.

name: alloc_placeholder_type_string
note: Copies text into the placeholder chunks (g_demangle_placeholder_chunk_current, 0x804-byte chunks {next, data[0x800]}, fill g_demangle_placeholder_chunk_used) and returns the copy; on allocation failure frees the whole placeholder chain and returns 0. Caller demangle_argument_list (the text a "$$nnn" placeholder stands for).

name: alloc_back_reference_string
note: Same as alloc_type_piece_string for the back-reference chunks (g_demangle_backref_chunk_current). Caller remember_argument_type.

name: push_demangle_token
note: g_demangle_tokens[*count].text = interned copy (intern_token_text), (*count)++. The kind field is set by the caller before the call. Caller demangle_argument_list.

name: push_type_piece
note: g_demangle_type_pieces[*count].text = alloc_type_piece_string(text), (*count)++. Kind set by the caller (2 type/name, 7 member pointer). Caller format_mangled_type_list.

name: compose_type_pieces
note: Turns the pushed type pieces into one type string: if the last piece is a type (kind 2) after a member pointer (kind 7) it inserts " " between them; then strcat's the pieces to out last-to-first (so "*" pushed before "int" gives "int*"), clearing their kinds, and sets *count = 0. Caller format_mangled_type_list.

name: demangle_argument_list
note: Formats a mangled argument-type list into work buffer `buffer` (2 from demangle_cpp_symbol_name). Splits codes into tokens (classify_mangle_code + the copy_* helpers) in g_demangle_tokens (kind 1 'F', 2 '_' return separator, 3 complete type). When a nested function type F<args>_<ret> completes, formats its return-type and argument tokens with format_mangled_type_list(..., 3) (work buffer 3), stores the joined text plus ")" as placeholder text (alloc_placeholder_type_string, g_demangle_placeholder_types) and replaces the tokens with a "$$%03d" token (00442bf8). Finally joins the tokens into g_demangle_joined_tokens (004462b0) and calls format_mangled_type_list(joined, buffer); frees the placeholder chunks. Returns low half 0 ok, 0xffff error, 2 out of memory. Caller demangle_cpp_symbol_name. LOW HALF: returns 2 bytes; the stock code leaves a leftover in the high half (Ghidra showed CONCAT22) and every caller reads only the low half: narrowing removed the callers' extraout_/CONCAT and added none.

name: parse_mangled_signature_kind
note: Classifies what follows the "__" of a mangled name: 'F' -> 0 (function); "Q..": 'F' -> 1 (member function of a qualified class), C/V..F -> 6 (cv member function), end -> 4 (static member); "<len>name": 'F' -> 2, C/V..F -> 7, end -> 3; C/V..F with no class -> 5. The function codes must be followed by a valid type code (classify_mangle_code 1..7 not 'F', or 0xb). Copies the raw class code to class_code (copy_qualified_name_code / copy_length_prefixed_name) and the C/V codes to cv_codes (copy_cv_qualifier_codes); *consumed = class code + cv length. 0xffff = not a mangled signature. Caller demangle_cpp_symbol_name. LOW HALF: returns 2 bytes; the stock code leaves a leftover in the high half (Ghidra showed CONCAT22) and every caller reads only the low half: narrowing removed the callers' extraout_/CONCAT and added none.

name: classify_mangle_code
note: Looks *code up in g_mangle_code_classes (004428c0, 0x21 entries {char *code; short class}) and returns the class in the low half, 0xffff if absent: 1 U/C/V/S qualifier, 2 basic type v c s i l f d r e m, 3 P/R, 4 F, 5 digit (length-prefixed name), 6 A, 7 M, 8 T, 9 $, 0xa '_', 0xb Q. Callers demangle_argument_list, parse_mangled_signature_kind, format_mangled_type_list. LOW HALF: returns 2 bytes; the stock code leaves a leftover in the high half (Ghidra showed CONCAT22) and every caller reads only the low half: narrowing removed the callers' extraout_/CONCAT and added none.

name: find_type_qualifier_code
note: Index of *code in g_mangle_qualifier_names (004429c8: U unsigned, C const, V volatile, S signed), -1 if absent. Caller format_mangled_type_list.

name: find_basic_type_code
note: Index of *code in g_mangle_basic_type_names (004429e8: v void, c char, s short, i int, l long, f float, d double, r long double, e ..., m enum), -1 if absent. Caller format_mangled_type_list.

name: find_declarator_code
note: Index of *code in g_mangle_declarator_names (00442a38: P "*", R "&", F ")(", M "::*"), -1 if absent. Caller format_mangled_type_list.

name: find_operator_name_code
note: strcmp of name against the 0x2a codes of g_mangle_operator_names (00442a58: "__cl" operator(), "__vc" operator[], "__nw" operator new, ... "__rm" operator->*), returns the index or -1. Caller demangle_cpp_symbol_name (prints the second column).

name: find_ctor_dtor_name_code
note: strcmp of name against g_mangle_ctor_dtor_names (00442ba8: "__ct" -> "", "__dt" -> "~"), returns 0/1 or -1. Caller demangle_cpp_symbol_name (prints prefix + class name).

name: format_mangled_type_list
note: Formats a list of mangled types into work buffer `buffer` (1/2/3), separated by "," (00442bd4). Clears the buffer (clear_work_buffer), the piece and back-reference tables, allocates the string chunks (allocate_demangle_string_chunks). Per code class: qualifiers + basic types / enum names / class names into g_demangle_type_piece; P/R/F/M declarators via find_declarator_code; A arrays (format_array_dimensions, parenthesised when pieces exist); T back references (format_type_back_reference); $ placeholders (format_placeholder_type); Q/<len> class names (format_qualified_name / parse_length_prefixed_name); each complete type is composed (compose_type_pieces), appended and remembered for back references (remember_argument_type). End: free_demangle_string_chunks, returns 0 low half; 0xffff/-1 errors. Callers demangle_cpp_symbol_name (conversion operator type, buffer 2), demangle_argument_list. LOW HALF: returns 2 bytes; the stock code leaves a leftover in the high half (Ghidra showed CONCAT22) and every caller reads only the low half: narrowing removed the callers' extraout_/CONCAT and added none.

name: parse_length_prefixed_name
note: <len><name> -> dst = name (NUL-terminated), *consumed = digits + len. 0xffff if len is 0. Callers format_class_scope_prefix, format_qualified_name, format_mangled_type_list, format_member_pointer_class. LOW HALF: returns 2 bytes; the stock code leaves a leftover in the high half (Ghidra showed CONCAT22) and every caller reads only the low half: narrowing removed the callers' extraout_/CONCAT and added none.

name: format_qualified_name
note: Q<n>__ + n length-prefixed names -> dst = "A::B::C" (components via parse_length_prefixed_name into g_demangle_qualified_component 004458b0, "::" between). *consumed = code length. Callers format_mangled_type_list, format_member_pointer_class. LOW HALF: returns 2 bytes; the stock code leaves a leftover in the high half (Ghidra showed CONCAT22) and every caller reads only the low half: narrowing removed the callers' extraout_/CONCAT and added none.

name: format_array_dimensions
note: copy_array_dimension_codes, then rewrites "A10_A3_" as "[10][3]" ('A' -> '[', '_' -> ']') into dst; *consumed = code length. SIG: Ghidra has an undefined return, but the function leaves copy_array_dimension_codes' status in EAX and format_mangled_type_list tests it ((short)ret != 0 -> return); listed in shcasm-ret4/use.txt. int keeps that. LOW HALF: returns 2 bytes; the stock code leaves a leftover in the high half (Ghidra showed CONCAT22) and every caller reads only the low half: narrowing removed the callers' extraout_/CONCAT and added none.

name: format_type_back_reference
note: T<n>: copies the text of the n-th (1-based) remembered argument type (g_demangle_back_references, entry n-1) to dst; *consumed = 1 + digits. 0xffff if n is 0 or the entry is unused. Caller format_mangled_type_list. LOW HALF: returns 2 bytes; the stock code leaves a leftover in the high half (Ghidra showed CONCAT22) and every caller reads only the low half: narrowing removed the callers' extraout_/CONCAT and added none.

name: format_member_pointer_class
note: M<class>: dst = class name (format_qualified_name for 'Q', else parse_length_prefixed_name, via g_demangle_member_class_text 00446ab0) + "::*" (00442bd0); *consumed = 1 + class code length. Returns the helper's status. Caller format_mangled_type_list (pushes the piece with kind 7).

name: format_placeholder_type
note: $$nnn: the 3 digits after "$$" index g_demangle_placeholder_types; copies its text (the function type demangle_argument_list stored) to dst, *consumed = 5. 0xffff if the entry is unused. Caller format_mangled_type_list. LOW HALF: returns 2 bytes; the stock code leaves a leftover in the high half (Ghidra showed CONCAT22) and every caller reads only the low half: narrowing removed the callers' extraout_/CONCAT and added none.

name: copy_cv_qualifier_codes
note: Copies the leading 'C'/'V' codes to dst (NUL-terminated), *consumed = their count; returns 0 only if they are followed by 'F', else 0xffff. Caller parse_mangled_signature_kind.

name: remember_argument_type
note: g_demangle_back_references[g_demangle_back_reference_count] = {1, alloc_back_reference_string(text)}, count++. The table "T<n>" codes refer to. Caller format_mangled_type_list.

name: initialize_work_buffers
note: Existing name. The three work buffers are the demangler's text buffers (append_to_work_buffer): text pointer 0, capacity 0x400, length 0 each. Caller shcasm_main.

name: free_work_buffers
note: Existing name. Frees the three work buffers' text (FUN_00435290).

name: append_to_work_buffer
note: strcat text to work buffer 1 (g_work_buffer_a), 2 (b) or other (c), doubling the capacity (+4) and reallocating (malloc/copy/free) when length + strlen + 1 would pass it; length += strlen. Returns 1, or -1 on allocation failure. Callers demangle_cpp_symbol_name, format_mangled_type_list.

name: reset_work_buffer
note: Allocates work buffer 1/2/3's text at its capacity if not yet allocated, then empties it (text[0] = 0, length 0). Returns 1, -1 on allocation failure. Callers demangle_cpp_symbol_name (1, 2), demangle_argument_list (3).

name: clear_work_buffer
note: Empties work buffer 1/2/3 (text[0] = 0, length 0) without allocating. Caller format_mangled_type_list.

name: allocate_demangle_string_chunks
note: Allocates the first 0x808-byte chunk of the type-piece chain (g_demangle_piece_chunk_first/current) and of the back-reference chain (g_demangle_backref_chunk_first/current) if not present; on failure free_demangle_string_chunks. Caller format_mangled_type_list.

name: free_demangle_string_chunks
note: Frees every chunk of the type-piece chain and then of the back-reference chain (following +0 next). Does not clear the head pointers. Callers format_mangled_type_list (end), alloc_type_piece_string / alloc_back_reference_string / allocate_demangle_string_chunks (on failure).

name: configure_signal_handlers
note: Existing name. mode != 1: signal() for SIGINT(2), SIGBREAK(0x15), SIGILL(4), SIGABRT(0x16), SIGSEGV(0xb) (the handler argument is not shown by the export).

name: handle_interrupt_signal
note: CREATE: not a function in the analysis (only configure_signal_handlers pushes its address). The SIGINT handler: close_and_delete_temp_files, then exit(13).

name: handle_fault_signal
note: CREATE: not a function in the analysis (only configure_signal_handlers pushes its address). The handler of SIGFPE/SIGILL/SIGSEGV/SIGTERM/SIGBREAK (0x15, 4, 0x16, 0xb): close_and_delete_temp_files; for a C++ request (cpp_block) of stage 0 with errors and message_flags bit 0 clear it stores the request back (store_request_record_file(0, g_request_record_path)) and exits 7; else exit(15). Release 26 reaches it on the SH-4 inputs that fault in the superscalar scheduler.
